fact_text: Continuity in how government policies are implemented matters more than anything else for a sector's growth, and its results only show up over the long term.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Official State Bank figures for IT exports are cited as about 4.6 to 4.8 billion dollars for FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The 0.25% tax on IT exports is due to expire at the end of FY26, in June 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The IT industry wants the 0.25% export tax renewed for at least 10 years, because the policy's long-term effect depends on a stable tax rate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Foreign clients know that outsourcing to Pakistan carries a light 0.25% export tax, which the speaker said gives Pakistani firms an advantage in winning work.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: E-commerce is described as a fast-growing industry that has captured a good market, similar to textiles, but local policies, taxes and consultancy costs weigh on new businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Freelancers in Pakistan are taxed at about 1% of income.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: IT company employees pay tax of up to 35% once their salary reaches a certain bracket.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The gap between the roughly 1% freelancer tax and the up-to-35% salary tax pushes IT employees to leave salaried jobs and work as remote workers, which hurts large IT companies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The industry proposes that the law clearly define who counts as a remote worker, a freelancer and an IT company employee, so that taxes apply on a level basis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker said taxes abroad are largely fixed and differ by only about 1-2% between autos, clothing and electronics, unlike Pakistan where rates vary sharply by sector.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker said vehicles carry a very heavy tax burden in Pakistan, and petrol is also taxed extra, so buyers get little relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The mobile phone industry faces an ongoing dispute over tax on handsets that people buy abroad and bring in, and the speaker said the government keeps adding tax without relief.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Corporate debit cards exist, but freelancers and startups cannot repatriate funds through digital banking; only offline banking with forms is allowed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Many freelancers and IT companies keep their earnings in foreign accounts from which they can spend easily, rather than bringing the money home.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: Part of freelancers' earnings brought home through formal channels is recorded as home remittances rather than as IT exports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker said actual IT-related inflows are well above the official figure, citing a total of at least 10 billion dollars held by freelancers and companies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: According to the speaker, investor and industry confidence in the IT and e-commerce sectors has weakened since 2025 as tax measures took hold.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The speaker estimated that 24-hour digital repatriation of earnings could bring 4 to 5 billion dollars into Pakistan within two to three years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)

fact_text: The industry offered to support government tax collection if digital and cross-border payment gateways are allowed, since small and large businesses face payment challenges.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Digital Economy Faces Growth Challenge Amid Tax and Payment Issues | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-06-01)
